description:
Cast Mighty Mutanimals by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Mighty Mutanimals enters, its first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Mutant creature token.
When the Mutant enters, Mighty Mutanimals' second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals' second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 4.
